description: Phase 6ak gate — IF EXISTS on DROP / IF NOT EXISTS on CREATE. Idempotency modifiers; no new opcodes. max_invariant=43 unchanged.

cases.name: drop-table-if-exists-missing
cases.description: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS on non-existent table is a silent no-op.

cases.name: drop-table-without-if-exists-missing-still-errors
cases.description: Plain DROP TABLE still raises when target missing.

cases.name: create-table-if-not-exists-new
cases.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on new name creates the table.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (a INTEGER);

cases.name: create-table-if-not-exists-duplicate-suppressed
cases.description: Duplicate CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is silent no-op; existing table untouched.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (b TEXT);

cases.name: create-table-without-if-not-exists-duplicate-errors
cases.description: Plain CREATE TABLE on duplicate still raises STORAGE_TABLE_EXISTS.

program.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i ON t (a);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i ON t (a);

cases.name: if-not-exists-different-kind-not-suppressed
cases.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idx when idx is an INDEX — still raises, different object kind.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idx (b INTEGER);

cases.name: drop-table-if-missing-exists-token
cases.description: DROP TABLE IF <ident> is parse error — must be DROP TABLE IF EXISTS.

cases.name: case-insensitive-suppression
cases.description: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS matches case-insensitively against schema.
